description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the HibernateOrderDAO class related to order group operations in the OpenMRS API. It includes tests for saving, retrieving, and deleting order groups and attribute types, as well as handling various edge cases.

classes.name: HibernateOrderDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing HibernateOrderDAO's methods related to OrderGroup and OrderAttributeType entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by executing predefined datasets before each test.

methods.name: saveOrderGroup_shouldSaveOrderGroup
methods.description: Tests saving a new OrderGroup with associated Order in the database.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByEncounter_shouldFailGivenNullEncounter
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to getOrderGroupsByEncounter throws an APIException.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByPatient_shouldFailGivenNullPatient
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to getOrderGroupsByPatient throws an APIException.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByEncounter_shouldGetOrderGroupsFromAnEncounter
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of order groups linked to a specific encounter.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByPatient_shouldGetOrderGroupsGivenPatient
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of order groups linked to a specific patient.

methods.name: getAllOrderGroupAttributeTypes_shouldGetAllOrderGroupAttributeTypes
methods.description: Checks that all order group attribute types are retrieved.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByUuid_shouldGetOrderGroupAttributeTypeGivenUuid
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of an OrderGroupAttributeType by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeType_shouldReturnOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByName_shouldGetOrderGroupAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttributeType by its name and verifies its properties.

methods.name: deleteOrderGroupAttributeType_shouldDeleteOrderGroupAttributeTypeFromDatabase
methods.description: Deletes an OrderGroupAttributeType by UUID and verifies its removal.

methods.name: saveOrderAttributeType_shouldSaveTheProvidedOrderAttributeTypeToDatabase
methods.description: Creates and saves a new OrderAttributeType, then verifies its persistence and correctness.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeByName_shouldReturnOrderAttributeTypeUsingProvidedName
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of OrderAttributeType by name.

methods.name: deleteOrderAttributeType_shouldDeleteTheProvidedOrderAttributeTypeFromDatabase
methods.description: Deletes an OrderAttributeType and confirms its removal from the database.
